title: Task Budgets API Beta — Advisory Token Budget for Agentic Loops
description: Task Budgets are an advisory token budget covering the full agentic loop (thinking, tool calls, tool results, and output). Activated via beta header 'anthropic-beta: task-budgets-2026-03-13'. Usage: add output_config.task_budget = {type: 'tokens', total: 64000} to API calls. The model sees a running countdown and uses it to prioritize work and finish gracefully as budget runs out. Key properties: (1) Advisory (not hard stop — max_tokens is still the hard limit), (2) Carries forward across compaction cycles in long-running agents, (3) Opus 4.7 only. Distinct from CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS (which limits bash invocations) and max_tokens (which is a hard cut). Enables cost governance on agentic loops without per-request max_tokens micromanagement.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — registry has CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS (bash invocation cap) and max_tokens, but no advisory cross-loop token budget concept. Task Budgets are model-visible planning signals, not hard limits. Gap in registry under Token Efficiency Features / Reasoning & Thinking sections.
action_needed: Add to registry under Token Efficiency Features as ACTIVE (API beta). Evaluate for heartbeat/agentic pipeline use — budget carry-across compaction cycles is particularly relevant.

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic API beta (community_validation=100, maintenance=100). Integration currently blocked: requires passing beta header 'anthropic-beta: task-budgets-2026-03-13' in API calls — not available via claude -p CLI on Max plan (complexity=20). Capability expansion (70): genuinely novel advisory budget concept not in registry; carry-across-compaction-cycles is particularly relevant for our long-running heartbeat/agentic loops. Token efficiency (70): model-visible countdown enables graceful early termination instead of hard cutoff waste. Research needed: verify whether claude -p or Claude Code Routines expose a path to pass this beta header on Max plan, or whether this remains API-key-only.
research_questions: Can task budgets be activated via claude -p on Max plan (is there a --beta-header flag)?
Does Claude Code Routines (which doesn't require API key) support task budget headers?
